rules.description: Applicant must have reached State Pension age
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have reached State Pension age to claim Attendance Allowance. If you're under State Pension age, you may be able to claim Personal Independence Payment (PIP) instead.

rules.description: Applicant must have a physical disability, mental disability, or health condition
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have a disability or health condition that requires personal care or supervision

rules.description: Disability or condition must be severe enough to need help caring for yourself or supervision
rules.reason_if_failed: Your disability or condition must be severe enough that you need help with personal care or supervision for your safety

rules.description: Must have needed help for at least 6 months (unless end of life)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have needed help for at least 6 months before you can claim (unless you're claiming under special rules for end of life)

rules.description: Must be in Great Britain when claiming
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be in Great Britain when you claim. There are some exceptions for armed forces members and their families.

rules.description: Must have been in Great Britain for at least 2 of the last 3 years
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have been in Great Britain for at least 2 of the last 3 years (unless you're a refugee or have humanitarian protection status)

rules.description: Must be habitually resident in UK, Ireland, Isle of Man or Channel Islands
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be habitually resident in the UK, Ireland, Isle of Man or Channel Islands

rules.description: Must not be subject to immigration control (unless sponsored immigrant)
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot claim if you're subject to immigration control (unless you're a sponsored immigrant)

rules.description: Must not be getting DLA, PIP, ADP, SADLA or AFIP
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot get Attendance Allowance if you already receive Disability Living Allowance, Personal Independence Payment, Adult Disability Payment, Scottish Adult Disability Living Allowance or Armed Forces Independence Payment

rules.description: Cannot usually get if in care home paid for by local authority
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot usually get Attendance Allowance if you live in a care home and your care is paid for by your local authority. You can still claim if you pay for all your care home costs yourself.

explanation_template: Attendance Allowance eligibility: {outcome}. Rate: {rate} per week based on care needs.

edge_cases.description: Medical professional has said applicant might have 12 months or less to live
edge_cases.action: Fast-track application under special rules. Automatically award higher rate (£110.40). No face-to-face assessment required. Requires SR1 form from medical professional.
Hand off to Social Security Scotland. Applicant must apply for Pension Age Disability Payment instead of Attendance Allowance.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is moving from England/Wales to Scotland
edge_cases.action: Inform applicant: Attendance Allowance will stop 13 weeks after move. Must apply for Pension Age Disability Payment as soon as possible after moving.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is moving from Scotland to England/Wales and receives Pension Age Disability Payment
edge_cases.action: Applicant must report move to Social Security Scotland and apply for Attendance Allowance immediately to avoid payment gaps.

edge_cases.description: Unclear how disability or health condition affects applicant
edge_cases.action: Arrange face-to-face assessment with medical professional to examine applicant and clarify care needs.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is refugee or has humanitarian protection status
edge_cases.action: Waive the 2-of-3-years Great Britain residency requirement. Process application under standard rules.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is member or family member of armed forces
edge_cases.action: Apply exceptions to Great Britain presence requirement. Process application with armed forces considerations.
If approved, reduce Attendance Allowance by the amount of Constant Attendance Allowance received.
